Name: (CC) Midges Gnats and Flies
Author: KBKuriations
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=3][center][/center][/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=3][center][i]Someone call Moses; the plagues are escaping Egypt![/i][/center][/size][/color]

This mod adds a set of little flies/gnats/midges to your game, for more immersive annoyance. They're just ambient; they don't bite the player, livestock, or crops (if someone wants to come up with a way to add this feature, or to make a "plague of pestilence" for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868]Weather Wonders[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23734]Project Danger Weather[/url], I give permission for you to use my sprites). They come in various shades of grey, as well as dark and light rainbow hues, with transparent wings. There's even a couple that cycle through the rainbow as they fly, simulating light refraction (prismatic pests?).


Pests will annoy you every season but winter, on just about any outdoor map, including ones from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], ﻿﻿﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mt. Vapius[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23468]Forager's Nooks and Cranies[/url] (none required, but all supported). You shall not escape the pestilence! [b]MWAHAHAHAHA[/b][i]hackcough[/i]hairball...
